reasons: Reduced PK, transferred assay kinetics, prescribed target exposure, and hypothetical interventions.

hypothesis.predicted_outcome: Compare occupancy retention under stated assumptions

assumptions.description: One compartment using copied Vc and linear CL components; no clinical PK fit or late-washout validation.
Apparent 25 C SPR kinetics applied to effective sites; no in vivo or temperature transfer validation.
Alpha=1; target-site exposure is prescribed, not measured.
Nondepleting drug reservoir and fixed independent effective sites; no internalization, turnover, or bivalent avidity.
One 8 mg/kg infusion over 1.5 hours at t=0 for 66 kg, no repeat doses, A0=0 and occupancy0=0, 180-day horizon, 90% analytical threshold. Not a clinical regimen.
Changes to half-life and koff are hypothetical independent controls at fixed remaining parameters.

warnings: One-compartment linear PK is a conditional reduction, not a calibrated clinical concentration model.

claims: Under this conditional reduced model, endpoint occupancy at 180 days is 62.90% (baseline), 99.82% (half-life ×3), and 94.44% (affinity ×10).
Computed occupancy AUC over 180 days is 4090.26, 4317.50, and 4291.59 hours respectively.
Both alternatives remain above the chosen analytical occupancy threshold at the horizon; their time-to-loss comparison is censored.

follow_up_experiments: Extend the observation window to determine when each alternative falls below the chosen analytical occupancy threshold.
Measure free trastuzumab exposure at relevant HER2 target sites before interpreting modeled occupancy in tissue.
Measure matched intact-antibody association and dissociation rates against HER2 at 37 °C.
Measure PK, binding rates, and manufacturability for actual engineered variants rather than assuming independent changes.

paper_summaries.locator: Table 1: non-AGC central volume and linear clearance; population-model methods/results
paper_summaries.finding: Quartino and colleagues modeled serum trastuzumab exposure across clinical studies using two compartments and parallel linear and nonlinear elimination.
paper_summaries.hypothesis_relevance: Provides the PK reference for asking how slower elimination changes exposure over time.
paper_summaries.use_in_model: The reviewed volume and linear-clearance inputs provide the PK starting point. In the reference preset, tripling half-life reduces clearance at fixed volume, changing concentration and consequently occupancy.
paper_summaries.limitation: Hypothesim reduces the published model to one linear compartment. Its curves are exploratory reductions, not reproduced patient predictions.

paper_summaries.locator: Table 3: intact trastuzumab row; SPR methods 4.11
paper_summaries.finding: Selis and colleagues compared intact trastuzumab with antibody fragments. Their SPR measurements report association and dissociation rates for intact trastuzumab against immobilized HER2.
paper_summaries.hypothesis_relevance: Supplies the matched kinetic rates used to explore affinity changes alongside changes in elimination.
paper_summaries.use_in_model: The intact-antibody rate pair provides the occupancy starting point, with KD calculated as koff/kon. In the reference preset, the affinity alternative lowers koff tenfold at fixed kon and does not change the PK concentration curve.
paper_summaries.limitation: These are apparent assay kinetics transferred to an effective-site model, not measured tissue occupancy. Fragment engineering in this paper also motivates checking whether PK and affinity can really change independently.
